messages:
sarah: Morning — quick standup-lite. What I did: synced with infra about canary thresholds, drafted rollout spec for v2 routing. Blockers: waiting on perf numbers to pick fallback strategy. Today: finalize spec, coordinate canary schedule, get console flags ready. Need quick call on fallback behavior: Option A = graceful degrade to smaller model variant; Option B = spike-throttle/queue. Prefer A but want input. Link to spec: https://redwood.internal/specs/v2-routing

maya: Ran perf suite last night, attached short summary. P95 ~ 180ms, P99 ~ 420ms under steady load; under bursts latency jumps. Option A seems safer for UX, but we need a small KV-cache tweak to avoid cold-starts on fallback. No blocker to proceed if we budget a short kernel patch.

alex: +1 for Option A. Also we need an explicit console toggle and rollout checklist for Dedicated customers. I can own console changes and the PR. Will add a feature flag: `v2_fallback_model` with canary cohorts.

liam: Heads up — embedding regen for search will be paused during canary window to reduce noise. Filing ticket RGW-1234. No blockers from ML infra side.

olivia: Can review spec at 2pm PST. Can take on QA checklist and smoke tests for canary. One quick ask: define success metrics for quality regression (precision@10 drop tolerated?).

sarah: Good call @olivia — propose success criteria: embedding precision drop <= 1.5% and error rate increase < 0.5%. If QA agrees we can auto-fail and rollback. @maya can you confirm perf gist link?

maya: Uploaded perf logs: https://redwood.internal/perf/1841239999 — cache tweak reduced cold-start penalty in local testing. If we land that small change, p99 under burst looks acceptable.

alex: I'll open the console PR today, target merge by EOD behind feature flag. Will include migration notes for Dedicated.

olivia: I'll draft QA checklist now and post it here for review. Will include rollback triggers, smoke scripts, and ramp schedule.

tom (eng-sre): Reserving extra capacity Tue 10–12am PST for canary. Also adding temporary alert thresholds to catch token-rate spikes.

sarah: Thanks all — sounds like consensus toward Option A with the cache tweak and console flag. If no major objections by noon, I'll mark spec ready for rollout. Drop any final concerns here or DM me. :rocket:
